newsitem.title: GERMANY: ContiTech says 96 profits climb strongly.
newsitem.headline: ContiTech says 96 profits climb strongly.

text.p: ContiTech Holding GmbH, the technical products divison of tyre maker Continental AG, said on Tuesday that profits before taxes and interest climbed 46 percent to 177 million marks in 1996.
ContiTech attributed the profit increase, which came on a 6.2 percent sales increase to 2.97 billion marks, to cost-cutting and efforts to increase productivity.

The company also said that business had developed positively during the first quarter of the year with sales between January and March climbing four percent from a year ago. --Frankfurt Newsroom + 49 69 756525
